<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/schema-to-markdown.py — do not edit. Regenerate from public/schemas/. -->

A shortcut to other content, placed in a container's library tree.

A `Reference` is a pointer wearing a name — it holds no content, only a link. Its purpose is to
let one piece of content appear in more than one place without being duplicated: a monster
defined in a compendium can be listed under the chapter it ambushes the party in, and a map can
be filed under two locations at once.

It differs from an inline link in `Page/content` by being a first-class library item: it sits
in the tree with its own name, position and `parentId`, so it shows up when browsing rather
than only when reading.

- Note: The link is a soft one. Nothing keeps a reference and its target in step, so
  `linkedObject()` returns `nil` once the target is gone.

- SeeAlso: `Group`, `Page`, `Module`

[View JSON Schema](/schemas/Reference.schema.json)

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | Yes | The unique identifier for this reference. A UUID string automatically generated when the reference is created. This serves as the primary key in the Realm database. |
| `name` | `string` | Yes | The display name of the reference. Shown in the library in place of the target's own name, so a link can be labelled for the context it appears in. <br>**Examples:** `"Klarg (Bugbear Boss)"` |
| `slug` | `string` | Yes | A URL-friendly identifier for the reference. <br>**Examples:** `"klarg-bugbear-boss"` |
| `reference` | `string` | No | The app URL of the content this reference points at. <br>**Examples:** `"/monster/bugbear"`; `"/map/cragmaw-hideout"`; `"/page/goblin-ambush"` SeeAlso: `linkURL`, `linkedObject()` |
| `parentId` | `string` | Yes | The identifier of the `Group` containing this reference in the library tree. Empty for a reference at the top level of its container. |
| `rank` | `integer` | Yes | The manual sort position among its siblings. Lower values sort first. |
